Method of Attack: Exploiting a vulnerable GIGABYTE driver (gdrv.sys) to disable Windows driver signature enforcement, allowing installation of a malicious unsigned kernel driver (rbnl.sys) that terminates antivirus and security software processes to enable ransomware execution
Using the vulnerable GIGABYTE driver as a wedge to load a second unsigned malicious driver
Terminating and deleting antivirus and security software processes and files
Deploying ransomware executable after disabling security protections
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CORE-2018-0007 vulnerability in GIGABYTE gdrv.sys driver
Use of vulnerable signed driver to bypass Microsoft driver signature enforcement
Indicators of Compromise: Installation of vulnerable GIGABYTE gdrv.sys driver
PLIST.TXT file listing processes and services to terminate/delete
